items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: He used to have me to play... Yeah, he played with Jesse Jackson.

ctx.x: Don't turn it over. Which one was it? Tell him to turn it over. The other side. He said, turn it over on the other side.

Jesse Jackson. He has, huh? Jesse Jackson. Oh, he was a guitar player. You remember him? He used to have a little help in the mouth. He used to get better weight. He used to have two guitars. He said, well, we don't really play, but he would make motion. I think he would play, but he could make motion. I think he would play, but he couldn't make it, but he had all that work he used to get in there. Who'd he have in his band? Oh, Scott. He's a good bass player. You remember him? You remember Prince, Eddie Scott?…
Ask him who Jesse Jackson had in his band.
